values.场景提示词:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the small home study in <Picture 1>: a nearly square space of about ten square metres with dark blue-grey walls, pale wood flooring and a light rug. Its fixed layout is as follows: on the front wall, in front of the rain-covered window, stands a dark wooden desk carrying a lit laptop, a warm desk lamp, a pen cup and a stack of books, with a black swivel chair in front of it; along the right wall runs a row of wooden sideboards whose top carries two black speakers, a small potted plant and a black-and-white decorative print; on the left wall are a warm floor lamp, a low cabinet and a small bookshelf; on the back wall are a dark wooden door, another low cabinet with a warm desk lamp and a stack of books on it, and a vertical LED light strip; along the walls and in the corners are distributed a chalkboard print, a coat rack and several potted plants.
<Picture 1> provides views of this same study in the four directions of front, right, back and left, and is used to fix the furniture placement, materials and light ratio of each direction, the four of them together describing one and the same continuous space. The camera height and orientation of these four views are not perfectly regular and serve only as a reference for direction and layout. The reference image is a layout basis only: it never appears in the frame itself, and none of its panel divisions, borders, collage seams or annotation text appear in the picture either; the target video must contain no text, subtitle, caption, watermark or interface element at all, and the picture must stay completely wordless from beginning to end. These four directions are the orientations the camera passes through in turn while rotating in place; the camera does not stop, stick or slow down at any one of them, and does not treat them as keyframes that need to be held or aligned.
<Subject 2> is the study's lighting design: the warm amber pools of light spilling from the desk lamp and the floor lamp, set against the cold blue night and the orange-red neon smeared across the wet glass.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a single continuous 360-degree clockwise pan inside <Subject 1>. The layout of this small study is defined by the four directional views of <Picture 1>. The camera is fixed at the exact centre of the room with its line of sight kept level and performs only a horizontal rotation in place without moving its position; the camera turns at a constant angular velocity and a uniform speed, with the speed unchanged throughout, pausing for 0.5 seconds only at the three positions of 90 degrees, 180 degrees and 270 degrees, and at all other times neither lingering, accelerating, decelerating nor jumping, finally returning to the opening orientation at that same uniform speed, while the warm-and-cold light ratio of <Subject 2> stays stable through the whole process.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the room proportions, wall colour, wood floor and rug, furniture placement, prop positions and materials are all retained according to <Picture 1>.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] layout reference): fully_preserved - the four directional views each correspond to one of the four cardinal directions the camera passes through while rotating in place and correct the furniture placement and light ratio of that direction, and its burned-in annotations count as non-reproducing notes.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the balance between the warm interior light and the cold neon outside the window is held from start to finish.

detailed_description:
The target video has a live-action cinematic texture with restrained and slightly desaturated colour, a deep depth of field indoors that keeps every prop clearly readable, and a quiet late-night atmosphere; the camera movement is smooth and continuous from beginning to end at a constant angular velocity, and no motion blur or smearing appears in the frame; no text, subtitle, caption, watermark or interface element appears anywhere in the picture during the entire shot.
[Shot 1] A single continuous eye-level shot opens inside <Subject 1>, settling on the front layout: the dark desk faces the camera with the lit laptop and the warm desk lamp on it, behind it the rain-covered window and the orange-red city neon, in the foreground the black swivel chair standing on the light rug, on the left wall in turn a chalkboard print, a coat rack with a coat hanging on it and a tall fiddle-leaf fig, and on the right wall the wooden sideboard carrying two black speakers, a small potted plant and a black-and-white decorative print. The camera is fixed at the exact centre of the room at a height of about one and a half metres and performs only a horizontal rotation in place for the whole shot, never tracking along the walls, never flying around the room, never pushing in, pulling back or rising, and never changing its height; the lens stays perfectly level, with no tilt, no side lean and no roll. From the opening moment the camera turns clockwise in place at a constant angular velocity and a uniform speed: all the furniture, objects, plants and light fixtures in the room stay fixed and motionless through the whole process, while the walls, door, window and floor enter the frame only as the camera orientation changes and never shift, slide, increase, decrease or deform. The rotation speed stays strictly unchanged for the entire shot, each quarter turn taking the same amount of time, with no acceleration, deceleration, stutter, jump cut or softening of the picture, and no lingering or sticking at any orientation. After a uniform quarter turn the camera pauses for 0.5 seconds at the 90-degree position, where the picture is the right-side layout: the window and the desk have moved to the left edge of the frame, the sideboard with the speakers sits centred with the black swivel chair in front of it, the right edge is a stretch of blank wall, and a cardboard storage box stands on the floor in the lower right corner; the instant the pause ends, the camera immediately resumes its original constant angular velocity and keeps rotating in place. After a uniform second quarter turn the camera pauses for 0.5 seconds at the 180-degree position, where the picture is the back layout: the dark wooden door with its metal handle sits left of the centre line, at the left edge of the frame are the wooden sideboard and the two black speakers stacked on its top, the desk with the warm desk lamp and the stack of books occupies the middle, and the vertical LED light strip and the coat rack with a coat hanging on it stand along the right wall with scattered plants and boxes below them; the instant the pause ends, the camera immediately resumes its original constant angular velocity and keeps rotating in place. After a uniform third quarter turn the camera pauses for 0.5 seconds at the 270-degree position, where the picture is the left-side layout: the warm floor lamp (a cream square shade), the low cabinet and the small bookshelf line up along the left side, the two stacked cardboard storage boxes and the hook rack sit centred, the hanging chalkboard print, the coat and several potted plants extend along the right wall, and a corner of the desk with the laptop appears at the far right edge of the frame; the instant the pause ends, the camera immediately resumes its original constant angular velocity and keeps rotating in place. The final quarter turn likewise keeps this constant angular velocity and comes firmly back to the opening orientation, so that the first frame and the last frame match exactly. The whole pan is one uninterrupted locked-off long take with no cut, jump or sudden change of speed anywhere in it. Throughout the rotation the room remains one and the same continuous space: the right edge of the picture at each orientation continues seamlessly into the left edge of the next, the front joining the right, the right joining the back, the back joining the left and the left joining back to the front, and every object keeps a single fixed position. Seen from directly above, <Subject 1> is nearly square: the desk and the swivel chair sit towards the back at the centre against the window wall, the rug and the open floor space lie at the front left, the sideboard, speakers and decorative print run along the right wall, the floor lamp, low cabinet and small bookshelf along the left wall, and the wooden door, the second low cabinet and the LED light strip along the back wall. <Subject 2> holds at every angle, the warm amber pools under the lamps reflecting the cold blue night and the orange-red neon on the wet glass.

overall_soundscape:
Fine rain keeps tapping against the window glass, the laptop fan hums low, and there is a faint electrical buzz under the desk lamp; the moving camera carries a slight creak of the wooden floor, and outside the window a car occasionally hisses over the wet asphalt.

non_diegetic_music:
Sparse low piano advances at a slow tempo over a sustained string bed, kept extremely light and even through the whole circular pan, lifting slightly only as the camera passes the wooden door and settling again as it returns to the desk.

## 0032_参考场景 (REF2VA 8秒/24fps/4步/20步 可切)

- 模型: minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
- 采样: euler + simple, 4 步; shift 12.0/3.0; Sage 加速(H3 专用)
- 帧数 = 秒数x24 对齐 17k+5 网格
- 输出: 24fps
- 切换: FallingTSSwitch — True=4步 (上方采样参数: turbo LoRA + euler + shift 6/3)
                          False=20步 (无 LoRA + res_multistep + simple + 模型默认 shift, 不经 SigmaShift)
- 缓存: EasyCache (0.2/0.15/0.7) 仅挂 20步分支; 4步分支只用 LoRA, 不经过缓存
